sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
Heroes of the Storm features a huge amount of Maps,
each of them needing a different strategy to succeed,
even if the general approach is approximately the same.
To learn how to draft and play on each Map available,
take a look at our Map Guides linked below.

sections.title: Alterac Pass
sections.text:
Alterac Pass is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Warcraft universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Cavalries. One per lane,
they will fight alongside the team who freed them from Prison Camps,
buffing allied Heroes nearby.
Alterac Pass Map Guide

sections.title: Battlefield of Eternity
sections.text:
Battlefield of Eternity is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Diablo universe.
The signature Objective of Infernal Shrines consists of Immortals: Ilarian and Beleth.
Defeating the enemy Immortal will make the allied Immortal join you in lane
to destroy enemy Structures with his powerful attacks.
Battlefield of Eternity Map Guide

sections.title: Blackheart's Bay
sections.text:
Blackheart's Bay is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Doubloons to collect from Treasure Chests
and Mercenary Camps. Whenever a team pays the required amount of Doubloons, Captain
Blackheart will use the cannons of his ghost ship to shoot at enemy Structures.
Blackheart's Bay Map Guide

sections.title: Braxis Holdout
sections.text:
Braxis Holdout is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Starcraft universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Beacons that reward Zerg Waves.
The team who wins the Objective will get a 100% power Zerg Wave,
the other team will get a less powerful one.
Braxis Holdout Map Guide

sections.title: Cursed Hollow
sections.text:
Cursed Hollow is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Tributes. Whenever a team
gets 3 Tributes, the Raven Lord casts a Curse on the enemy team,
weakening enemy Minions and disabling enemy Structures.
Cursed Hollow Map Guide

sections.title: Dragon Shire
sections.text:
Dragon Shire is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Shrines that reward a Dragon Knight.
The team who controls both Shrines can pilot the Dragon Knight, a powerful
Vehicle that can be used to deal heavy damage to enemy Structures.
Dragon Shire Map Guide

sections.title: Garden of Terror
sections.text:
Garden of Terror is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Seeds required to get Garden Terrors.
One per lane, they will fight alongside the team who gets 3 Seeds, temporarily
disabling enemy Structures on their path.
Garden of Terror Map Guide

sections.title: Hanamura Temple
sections.text:
Hanamura Temple is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Overwatch universe.
The signature Objective of this Map is a Payload. Once successfully escorted
to its final destination, it deals damage to enemy Structures.
On this Map, you can also find the Sentinel Camp, a unique Mercenary Camp
that deals a lot of damage to enemy Heroes and Structures.
Hanamura Temple Map Guide

sections.title: Haunted Mines
sections.text:
Haunted Mines is a 2-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map is an Undead Army. When active, each team
has to collect 55 Skulls. Once completed, each team will be rewarded with a
Grave Golem whose power is based on the Skulls collected by the corresponding team.
Haunted Mines Map Guide

sections.title: Infernal Shrines
sections.text:
Infernal Shrines is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Diablo universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Shrines. When active, each team
has to kill 40 Guardians. The first team who does that gets a Punisher,
a powerful unit that will enable a strong push.
Infernal Shrines Map Guide

sections.title: Sky Temple
sections.text:
Sky Temple is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Temples. When active,
Heroes can stand on them to fire laser shots at enemy Structures.
Sky Temple Map Guide

sections.title: Tomb of the Spider Queen
sections.text:
Tomb of the Spider Queen is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Webweavers. One per lane,
they will fight alongside the team who pays the required amount of Gems,
dealing heavy damage to enemy Structures on their way.
Tomb of the Spider Queen Map Guide

sections.title: Towers of Doom
sections.text:
Towers of Doom is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Nexus universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Altars. Cores have 40 Health
and cannot be attacked directly. When captured, Altars deal 1 damage to
the enemy Core, increased by 1 for each Bell Tower (Fort or Keep) under your
team's control. Bring the enemy Core to 0 Health to win the game.
Towers of Doom Map Guide

sections.title: Volskaya Foundry
sections.text:
Volskaya Foundry is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Overwatch universe.
The signature Objective of this Map is a Capture Point that
rewards a Triglav Protector. The team who wins the Objective can pilot
the Triglav Protector, a massive Vehicle with 2 seats that can be used
to deal damage to enemy Structures and to Shield allied Heroes.
Volskaya Foundry Map Guide

sections.title: Warhead Junction
sections.text:
Warhead Junction is a 3-lane Map belonging to the Starcraft universe.
The signature Objective of this Map are Warheads. They can be collected
and launched on a target location, usually to damage enemy Structures.
On this Map, you can also find the Slime Boss, a unique Mercenary Camp
that deals a huge amount of damage to enemy Heroes and Structures.
Warhead Junction Map Guide
See our Tier List Hub for further information »
